en_title: The Batman Part 2 Brings in Director Steven Soderbergh to Finish Film in Place of Matt Reeves
cn_title: 《新蝙蝠侠2》请索德伯格完成拍摄
subtitle: 延续里维斯的构想
opus_summary: 马特·里维斯因家庭事务暂离《新蝙蝠侠2》，索德伯格将协助完成最后几周的主体拍摄。里维斯在家远程参与，杀青后负责后期制作；影片仍定于2028年2月18日上映。

paragraphs.en: Ocean's 11 director Steven Soderbergh has been hired to finish filming The Batman Part 2 while Matt Reeves attends to a family matter.
paragraphs.cn: 马特·里维斯正在处理家庭事务，《十一罗汉》导演史蒂文·索德伯格已受聘完成《新蝙蝠侠2》的剩余拍摄。

paragraphs.en: It was reported earlier this month that The Batman Part 2 director Matt Reeves was abruptly stepping away from the project to attend to personal matters. This left the film in a strange state of limbo, but DC boss Peter Safran recently told IGN that the project would be finished . Now, we know how. Warner Bros. confirmed to Deadline that Ocean's 11 director Steven Soderbergh will helm and complete the superhero sequel during its final weeks of production.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候有报道称，《新蝙蝠侠2》导演马特·里维斯突然暂离项目，去处理私人事务。影片因此陷入了前景未明的尴尬境地，不过DC负责人Peter Safran近日向IGN表示，这个项目会完成。现在，我们知道影片将如何拍完了。华纳兄弟向Deadline确认，《十一罗汉》导演史蒂文·索德伯格将在这部超级英雄续作最后几周的拍摄中执导，完成剩余拍摄。

paragraphs.en: “As Matt Reeves continues to attend to an ongoing family matter, Steven Soderbergh, as an admirer of Matt’s work, approached Matt and will step in to help the writer-director complete the final weeks of principal photography on The Batman Part 2," a WB rep told Deadline. "Matt and Steven will work closely together with the actors and crew to fulfill Matt’s vision of the film.”
paragraphs.cn: 华纳兄弟的一位代表向Deadline表示：「马特·里维斯仍在处理一件尚未解决的家庭事务。史蒂文·索德伯格很欣赏马特的作品，因此主动联系了他，将协助这位编剧兼导演完成《新蝙蝠侠2》最后几周的主体拍摄。马特和史蒂文将与演员及剧组密切合作，实现马特对这部电影的构想。」

paragraphs.en: Soderbergh is working directly with Matt Reeves during this process, with Deadline reporter Justin Kroll noting that Reeves is working on the film remotely from his home. Once the movie is wrapped, Soderbergh will hand things back over to Reeves so he can handle the post-production process. The goal is to finish Reeves' original vision for the sequel as opposed to having Soderbergh do something radically different.
paragraphs.cn: 在此过程中，索德伯格将直接与马特·里维斯合作。Deadline记者Justin Kroll指出，里维斯正在家中远程参与影片制作。影片杀青后，索德伯格会将工作交还给里维斯，由后者负责后期制作。双方的目标是实现里维斯对这部续作的原本构想，而不是让索德伯格拍出一部截然不同的电影。

paragraphs.en: “I thought Matt Reeves’ work on The Batman was stunning; it was intentional, specific, and rigorously coherent," said Soderbergh. "The goal here is to work with Matt and his team to generate footage that will integrate seamlessly with what’s already been shot so Matt can properly finish his film.”
paragraphs.cn: 索德伯格表示：「我觉得马特·里维斯执导的《新蝙蝠侠》令人惊叹；他的创作意图明确，表达精准，整部作品严谨而连贯。我们这次的目标是与马特及其团队合作，拍出能与已有素材无缝衔接的镜头，让马特能够妥善完成自己的电影。」

paragraphs.en: As of right now, it's unclear if the stoppage will lead to another delay. The Batman Part 2 has already been pushed back several times and is currently due out February 2028 . Given it's expected that there isn't too much left to shoot on the movie, this may not create any significant setbacks.
paragraphs.cn: 目前尚不清楚此次停拍是否会导致影片再次延期。《新蝙蝠侠2》已经数次推迟上映，目前定于2028年2月上映。考虑到影片预计已没有太多内容需要拍摄，这次停拍或许不会严重影响制作进度。

paragraphs.en: Soderbergh is a pretty efficent director, often handling multiple production roles himself. He's known for having a firm handle on budgets and being able to shoot quickly, which is something that the studio will likely greatly appreciate in this situation. He also has an Oscar for Best Director, which gives him an extra degree of prestige.
paragraphs.cn: 索德伯格是一位效率颇高的导演，经常在制作中身兼数职。他以严格控制预算、拍摄速度快而闻名，在眼下的情况下，制片公司很可能会格外看重这些能力。他还曾获得奥斯卡最佳导演奖，这也为他增添了几分声望。

paragraphs.en: The Batman Part 2 is currently slated to hit theaters on February 18, 2028.
paragraphs.cn: 《新蝙蝠侠2》目前定于2028年2月18日上映。
